计划行交货日期必须是唯一必填业务输入，并在 A_PurchaseOrderScheduleLine.ScheduleLineDeliveryDate 上进行精确匹配。 / Schedule-line delivery date must be the sole required business input and must use exact matching on A_PurchaseOrderScheduleLine.ScheduleLineDeliveryDate.

采购组织、采购组、工厂、供应商和采购订单号必须保持可选；无值时必须删除整个过滤条件，有值时才按对应实体字段精确筛选。 / Purchasing organization, purchasing group, plant, supplier, and purchase order must remain optional; omit the whole filter when absent and apply exact filtering only when supplied.

跨步骤关联必须保留复合键分组：计划行到项目使用采购订单与项目，物料凭证项目到抬头使用凭证年度与凭证号。 / Cross-step bindings must preserve composite-key grouping: purchase order plus item for schedule-line-to-item binding, and document year plus document number for material-item-to-header binding.

输出必须以采购订单、项目和计划行为稳定业务键，并包含范围内的全部记录，包括正常、零入库及未找到凭证的记录。 / Output must use purchase order, item, and schedule line as stable business keys and retain every in-scope record, including normal, zero-receipt, and document-not-found records.

删除标识非空的项目必须单独标记；GoodsReceiptIsExpected=false 的项目必须分类为不适用，不得误报为未入库。 / Items with a deletion indicator must be identified separately; items with GoodsReceiptIsExpected=false must be classified as not applicable, not as not received.

净入库数量必须只基于完整的采购订单关联物料移动，保留 DebitCreditCode、取消标识和冲销键，并按单位分别汇总；不同单位不得直接相加。 / Net received quantity must use complete PO-linked movement evidence, retain debit/credit direction, cancellation flags, and reversal keys, and aggregate separately by unit; unlike units must never be added.

SAP 的 IsCompletelyDelivered 标识与计算得到的净入库数量必须分别展示；两者不一致时必须标记为需复核，而不是静默覆盖其中一个值。 / SAP IsCompletelyDelivered and calculated net receipt quantity must be shown separately; a disagreement must be flagged for review rather than silently overriding either value.

只有在交货完成标识为否且完整移动证据确认净入库为零时，才能分类为未入库；存在正净入库但未完成时应分类为部分入库。 / Classify an item as not received only when the delivery-complete flag is false and complete movement evidence confirms zero net receipt; classify positive net receipt without completion as partially received.

物料凭证过账日期必须来自按凭证年度和凭证号完整关联的抬头证据，不得从项目记录猜测。 / Material-document posting date must come from completely bound header evidence using document year and document number; it must not be inferred from item rows.

任何来源截断、有 top 限制、分页未结束、source_complete 不为 true、关联缺失或单位不可比时，都必须返回未知或证据不足，不得用零或完成状态填补。 / If any source is truncated, top-bounded, not fully paged, lacks source_complete=true, has missing bindings, or contains incomparable units, return unknown or insufficient evidence rather than substituting zero or a completion status.

每条客户业务事实必须引用当次运行的 SAP 证据；当前验证引用不得固定写入后续 Agent 运行。 / Every customer business fact must cite SAP evidence from its own run; the current validation references must not be hard-coded into later Agent executions.

正式验收前必须分别测试五个可选输入的省略、单独提供和组合提供路径；当前样本仅支持全部省略路径。 / Before formal acceptance, test omission, individual use, and combined use of all five optional inputs; the current sample supports only the all-omitted path.

只读查询验证、Agent 草稿生成、审核、发布和激活必须保持为独立门禁；任何验证结果都不得被描述为规则已实现或 Agent 已发布。 / Read-only query validation, Agent-draft generation, review, publication, and activation must remain separate gates; no validation result may be described as implemented rules or a published Agent.
